name: Thai Cashew Chicken Stir Fry
ingredients: 200g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, sliced into 1cm strips
1/2 red cayenne pepper, deseeded and finely sliced
unmapped: raw cashews (board has peanuts/almonds/walnuts/pistachios/mixed-nuts but no cashews id) - signature ingredient, good pricer-lane probe
fresh red cayenne pepper (loosely maps to serrano-peppers; no exact fresh red chili id)
why: Stir-fry-lane chicken (thigh strips flash-fried with cashews, onion, chili in an oyster/fish/soy pan sauce), no rice base - the published macros already exclude rice. 454 cal / 26 g protein / 17 g carb per serving sits squarely mid-band and comfortably under the 35 g carb ceiling. Adds Thai/Asian breadth to a pool already thick with creamy-Italian chicken skillets. Batches to 14 as 7x done in wok shifts, weigh-and-divide. Verified: read nutrition directly off the recipe card. Cashews are a genuine board gap - a deliberate pricer-lane probe, not an oversight.
